description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability rom step 1.
Repeat.
